name: Mary
source:
Mary runs an inn alongside with her sister, Erin. She is calm, refined and much less energetic than her younger sibling; however, just like Erin, Mary has an accepting nature and is kind to practically anybody regardless of their background.

She is highly skilled in medicine and is able to make various remedies to mend all sorts of illnesses or injuries. With this skill, she helped Lena get back on her feet after she got injured.
translation:
Mary runs an inn alongside with her sister, Erin. She is calm, refined and much less energetic than her younger sibling; however, just like Erin, Mary has an accepting nature and is kind to practically anybody regardless of their background.

She is highly skilled in medicine and is able to make various remedies to mend all sorts of illnesses or injuries. With this skill, she helped Lena get back on her feet after she got injured.
